name: ListVpds

parameters.help_en: The name of the VPD instance
parameters.name: vpd_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPD instance
parameters.name: vpd_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the CLB instance. Valid values:

Available: Normal.
Not Available: Not available.
Executing: The task is being executed.
Deleting: The account is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。可能值：

Available：正常 
Not Available：不可用
Executing：执行中
Deleting：删除中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the dependent resource information. We recommend that you do not query the dependent resource information when you query by page. You can query the dependent resource information separately when you delete it. Possible values:

true: with dependency information.
false: does not include dependency information
parameters.help_zh:
是否带依赖资源信息，建议分页查询的时候不查询依赖信息，删除的时候可以单独查询，可能值：

true : 带依赖信息
false ：不带依赖信息
parameters.name: with_dependence

parameters.help_en:
If you select a drop-down list, only the basic information (including the instance ID and instance name) is returned. Possible values:

true: Select Query Use from the drop-down list.
false: Normal queries are used
parameters.help_zh:
下拉选择时使用，只返回基础信息（包括实例ID、实例名称），可能值：

true ：下拉选择查询使用。
false ：正常查询使用
parameters.name: for_select

parameters.help_en:
Queries the information about a Lingjun CIDR block that is not bound to a Lingjun connection. Possible values:

true: filters out VPDs that have been bound to VCC
false: does not filter VPD that has been bound to VCC
parameters.help_zh:
查询未绑定VCC（灵骏连接）的VPD（灵骏网段）信息，可能值：

true : 过滤掉已绑定过VCC的VPD
false ：不过滤已绑定过VCC的VPD
parameters.name: without_vcc

parameters.help_en: Queries the network segments of Lingjun that are not bound to a specified Lingjun HUB
parameters.help_zh: 查询未绑定过指定灵骏HUB的灵骏网段信息
parameters.name: filter_er_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

For more information about resource groups, see Resource groups (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.29e15d7akXhpuu)
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the VPN attachment.

You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

You can specify at most 20 tag keys in each call
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以aliyun或者acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the VPN connection.

The tag value can be empty or a string of up to 128 characters. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://.

Each key-value pair must be unique. You can specify values for at most 20 tag keys in each call
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以aliyun或者acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Start value: 1 Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码。起始值：1，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable paged query
parameters.name: enable_page
